messages:
Priya: Quick Q — Sarah's PTO request for Dec 30–31 overlaps the year-end blackout. Her manager Ethan is OOO that week. Who can approve or delegate?
Sofia: If manager is OOO we need a formal delegator recorded in BambooHR + a Slack approval via the /pto workflow. Otherwise payroll won't honor carryover.
Ethan: Sorry, I'm on vacation. I can delegate approval to @Priya for that window. Is that enough?
Priya: I can approve but we need the delegation recorded and the carryover exception ticket opened because she hit the 8h carryover cap.
Sarah: Quick context — I had a medical day in Nov and couldn't use 9h PTO. Asking to carry 1 extra hour (total 9) into Jan. I attached the note to the HR form.
Sofia: OK — steps: 1) Ethan posts delegation (one-line) in this thread to confirm, 2) Priya runs /pto approve for Sarah, 3) Priya files carryover-exception form: https://redwood.company/hr/pto-exception (choose "manager-delegation") 4) Payroll needs confirmation before cutoff 2026-01-05.
Ethan: I confirm delegation to @Priya for Sarah (Dec 28–Jan 04). Approve any PTO and carryover up to 16h while I'm OOO.
Priya: Running the approval now. Command I used: ```/pto approve --user @Sarah --dates 2025-12-30,2025-12-31 --carryover 1h --reason "medical note attached"```
People Ops Bot: Delegation recorded: Ethan -> Priya (2025-12-28 to 2026-01-04). Carryover-exception form submitted (ID: CE-2047). Notifying Payroll.
Payroll Bot: Received CE-2047. Note: carryover above 8h requires manager sign-off + medical doc. Medical doc present. Payroll will process if final approval submitted before cutoff 2026-01-05 23:59 PST.
Priya: Final approval submitted in the system. I selected "exception: medical" and attached Ethan's delegation and Sarah's note.
Sarah: Thank you both! :pray: Will this affect my year-end payout?
Sofia: No payout changes — this is carryover into Jan. We'll update the PTO ledger after payroll runs. If anything delays, we'll ping you here.
Priya: Adding a quick policy note for future — we should add a tiny checkbox in the /pto flow that enforces manager delegation when manager OOO overlaps blackout. Filing a doc update ticket.
Sofia: Filing ticket now: DOC-3421 to update PTO workflow + add reminder text before submit.
Ethan: Thanks team. Back to vacation. :beach_with_umbrella:
Priya: Marked resolved from my side. Closing thread after payroll confirms.
People Ops Bot: Thread note: resolved -> awaiting payroll processing.
